datasets.title: Tennis Player Actions Dataset for Human Pose Estimation
datasets.scope: 2,000 COCO pose annotations: backhand, forehand, ready position, and serve
knownLimitations: All images come from one recorded athlete.
Frames are extracted from video and are not independent samples.
There are no serve-phase, technique-quality, racket, ball, or coaching labels.

datasets.title: Dataset for Exploratory Proof-of-Concept: Predicting the Outcome of Tennis Serves Using Motion Capture and Deep Learning
datasets.scope: Marker-based 3D serve trajectories and in/out/net outcome labels
knownLimitations: The associated study recruited only two right-handed male participants in one indoor environment.
The downloaded archive currently contains 42 motion files but only 41 outcome rows; 4D_115 has no matching outcome and must be excluded from supervised work.
Its markers do not match the Apple Vision 2D joint contract.
Outcomes are not technique-quality or coach-priority labels.

datasets.title: Tennis Shot Side-View and Top-View Data Set for 3D Reconstruction and Player Analysis in Tennis
datasets.scope: 472 paired side/top-view tennis-shot clips with landing coordinates
knownLimitations: The public description identifies straight and cross-court shots, not serve repetitions or serve technique labels.
The 12.42 GB archive was not ingested because it does not establish that the clips match ServeAI's serve-only task.
Landing coordinates are not coaching-quality or phase labels.

datasets.title: Penn Action Dataset
datasets.scope: 2,326 action videos including tennis serves with per-frame 2D pose labels

datasets.title: THETIS: Three-dimensional Tennis Shots
datasets.scope: 495 RGB serve clips from 55 subjects across flat, kick, and slice classes; 494 unique source videos after one exact duplicate is excluded
knownLimitations: The authors describe the dataset as freely available for research purposes; no commercial-use grant is stated.
The footage is frontal Kinect RGB, outside ServeAI's supported side and rear iPhone views.
Actions are staged indoors without a ball, so true toss and contact events are unavailable.
The dataset provides serve classes and participant groups, not phase, technique-quality, or coaching-priority labels.
p55_serflat_s2.avi and p55_serflat_s3.avi are byte-for-byte identical and one is excluded.

datasets.title: SportsPose
datasets.scope: 176,000 markerless 3D sports poses across 24 subjects and five sports

datasets.title: AthletePose3D
datasets.scope: High-speed sports 3D human poses and pretrained checkpoints
